facts.source: Audiophile Style, thread "HQPlayer settings for specific DACs", the author's replies : « DSD512 with default filters and ASDM7EC-fast » ; chip: four ES9039SPRO, per Apos, Linsoul, Conceptkart, Audiophonics and Headphone Zone listings read 2026-11-20, which also agree on an ES9311Q regulator and an XMOS XU216 interface.
facts.chip: Four ES9039SPRO (ESS), with an ES9311Q regulator and an XMOS XU216 interface.

notes._modulator_order: Overrides the ESS family's order 5, and the catalogue's own rule says why: order 5 is for "ESS chips earlier than the ES9039". The X30 runs four ES9039SPRO, so it is not one of them. This is the rule working rather than an exception to it - and it is independently confirmed by the author recommending a SEVENTH-order modulator for this device, which is what the record's own evidence already said and what made its old AKM filing look plausible.

_note: Lot repris du catalogue JSON d'origine. Sa preuve est la chaîne `source` de la fiche : à éclater en preuves par champ au fur et à mesure, car une seule citation pour dix faits est le défaut connu de ce lot. `notes` porte les gloses que la fiche d'origine attachait à tel ou tel champ.
